title: PushSubscription/set response
description: Response for PushSubscription/set (RFC 8620 §7.2 / §5.3). Has no accountId, no oldState and no newState.

created.description: Map of creation id to the server-set id and expires of each created PushSubscription.

updated.description: Map of successfully updated PushSubscription id to its server-side changes: {expires} when the server changed expires, otherwise null.

destroyed.description: PushSubscription ids that were successfully destroyed.

notCreated.description: Creation ids that failed, with a SetError.

notUpdated.description: PushSubscription ids that failed to update, with a SetError.

notDestroyed.description: PushSubscription ids that failed to destroy, with a SetError.
